name: Muster
summary: The service that owns session agents on one machine, and the federation that makes two of them look like one.
description: Muster runs as a per-user service on loopback and owns the sessions an agent works in, so a client can create, watch, answer and close them over one small HTTP API. It is a component: other apps list it under `requires`, and the installer sets up the user service and checks that it is healthy.

steps: Make sure tmux is installed (brew install tmux).
In Terminal, run the installer from the host: curl -fsSL <site>/muster/install.sh | sh
prompts: "muster: command not found": add ~/.local/bin to your PATH (the installer says when it is missing).
